scope: overtaking (passing another vehicle, and being passed)

vocabulary.definition: Changing lanes to move past a slower vehicle, then returning to the original lane.
A designated area for pedestrians to cross roads, marked by specific signs, overhead yellow lights, and pavement markings.
A line marking that separates lanes of traffic moving in the same direction and indicates that passing is allowed when safe.
A line marking that separates lanes of traffic and indicates that passing is not allowed.
A vehicle powered by a motor, as opposed to a bicycle or other human-powered vehicle.
A vehicle without a motor that is towed by another vehicle.
A motorized vehicle intended for recreational use, such as an ATV or off-road motorcycle.

rules.title: No passing near a pedestrian crossover
rules.when: within 30 metres of a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER
rules.statement: WHEN within 30 metres of a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER, the PASSER MUST NOT pass any vehicle.
rules.note: Stated on two pages, both times as a prohibition.

rules.title: No passing on a curve, hill, or near a bridge/tunnel
rules.when: on a curve in the road OR on or near a railway crossing OR on a hilltop OR near a bridge or tunnel that blocks view
rules.statement: WHEN on a curve in the road OR on or near a railway crossing OR on a hilltop OR near a bridge or tunnel that blocks view, the PASSER MUST NOT pass another vehicle.
rules.note: This rule applies to U-turns and three-point turns as well, as passing is not allowed in these situations.

rules.title: No passing when visibility is insufficient
rules.when: cannot see at least 150 metres in both directions
rules.statement: WHEN cannot see at least 150 metres in both directions, the PASSER MUST NOT make a U-turn.
rules.note: This rule is specifically for U-turns, but the principle of visibility applies to passing as well.

rules.title: Passing allowed with broken line
rules.when: there is a BROKEN LINE at the left of the PASSER's lane AND the way is clear AND enough broken line remains ahead to complete the PASS
rules.statement: WHEN there is a BROKEN LINE at the left of the PASSER's lane AND the way is clear AND enough broken line remains ahead to complete the PASS, the PASSER MAY pass.

vague_terms.explanation: no gap or sight distance given

rules.title: Passing not allowed with solid line
rules.when: there is a SOLID LINE at the left of the PASSER's lane
rules.statement: WHEN there is a SOLID LINE at the left of the PASSER's lane, the PASSER MUST NOT pass.

rules.title: Cyclists: one metre
rules.action: keep at least 1 metre between the vehicle and the CYCLIST, where practical
rules.statement: WHEN passing a CYCLIST, the DRIVER of a MOTOR VEHICLE MUST keep at least 1 metre between the vehicle and the CYCLIST, where practical.
rules.penalty: A fine and two demerit points.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say when 1 metre is impractical

rules.note: The same block states the penalty, and advises changing lanes to pass whenever possible; that is a separate ADVICE rule.

rules.title: Do not pass on the right except in specific cases
rules.unless: the PASSER is on a multi-lane or one-way road OR passing a streetcar OR passing a left-turning vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN passing on the right, the PASSER MUST NOT pass UNLESS the PASSER is on a multi-lane or one-way road OR passing a streetcar OR passing a left-turning vehicle.

rules.title: Do not pass on the shoulder
rules.statement: WHEN passing on the shoulder, the PASSER MUST NOT pass UNLESS passing a vehicle turning left.

rules.title: Do not pass a stopped school bus with flashing red lights
rules.when: a school bus has its overhead red lights flashing OR its stop arm activated
rules.unless: the PASSER is on a road with a median strip AND is approaching from the opposite direction
rules.statement: WHEN a school bus has its overhead red lights flashing OR its stop arm activated, the PASSER MUST NOT pass the school bus UNLESS the PASSER is on a road with a median strip AND is approaching from the opposite direction.
rules.penalty: A fine and six demerit points for a first offence.
rules.note: The PASSER must stop at least 20 metres away from the school bus.

rules.title: Yield to vehicle passing you
rules.action: move to the right and allow the passing vehicle to pass
rules.statement: WHEN another vehicle is passing you, the DRIVER MUST move to the right and allow the passing vehicle to pass.

rules.title: Procedure for passing
rules.action: signal, check mirrors and blind spot, ensure the way is clear, change lanes, accelerate to pass, and return to the original lane when safe
rules.statement: WHEN passing another vehicle, the PASSER MUST signal, check mirrors and blind spot, ensure the way is clear, change lanes, accelerate to pass, and return to the original lane when safe.

vague_terms.explanation: no specific distance or time given
no specific distance or time given
